title: Emo-DVS: A Multimodal Benchmark for Privacy-Aware Emotion Recognition with Event Cameras
abstract: arXiv:2609.06928v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Emotion analysis is a fundamental task in computer vision, but its practical deployment remains constrained by the privacy risks inherent to conventional RGB cameras. Bio-inspired event cameras present a promising hardware-level solution because they capture asynchronous brightness changes, thereby reducing exposure of facial identity details while leveraging high dynamic range for robust perception under challenging illumination conditions. Despite these advantages, existing event-based methods struggle in complex real-world settings due to limited dataset scales, simple acquisition conditions, and reliance on single-modality visual cues. translated_title: Emo-DVS：基于事件相机的隐私感知情绪识别多模态基准数据集
translated_abstract: 情绪分析是计算机视觉中的一项基础任务，但其实际部署仍然受到传统RGB相机固有的隐私风险的限制。受生物启发的事件相机提供了一种有前景的硬件级解决方案，因为它们捕捉异步亮度变化，从而在减少面部身份细节暴露的同时，利用高动态范围在具有挑战性的光照条件下实现稳健感知。尽管有这些优势，现有的基于事件的方法由于数据集规模有限、采集条件简单以及依赖单模态视觉线索，在复杂的现实环境中表现不佳。为解决这些问题，我们建立了一个包含事件、音频和文本模态的具有挑战性的三模态基准，并提出了信息引导门控融合（IGF）框架，该框架首先在Emo-DVS的FAU子集上预训练事件编码器以捕捉细粒度的面部动态，然后采用自适应……
tldr: 该论文提出了包含事件相机、音频和文本三模态的Emo-DVS隐私保护情绪识别基准数据集，并设计了信息引导门控融合框架以提升复杂现实场景下的情绪识别性能。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Emo-DVS, a tri-modal benchmark (event, audio, and text) for privacy-aware emotion recognition, along with an Information-Guided Gated Fusion (IGF) framework to enhance recognition performance in complex real-world scenarios.
